nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the gambling/reward logic is active.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; only transfers from it can win rewards.
Incrementing nonce mixed into the pseudo-random hash.
Owner-supplied seed used for the win randomness.
Derived seed used for burn-rate and win randomness.
Chance rate set to 100 when the game starts (written but never read).
Owner-only initializer that sets liquidityPool, seeds and chanceRate and flips gameStarted.
ERC20 transfer override that routes the amount through the game logic.
ERC20 transferFrom override that routes the amount through the game logic.
View returning the gameStarted flag.
Private helper that plays the game, awards rewards and burns a random portion of the amount.
Mints a 10x reward to the recipient when the sender is the liquidity pool and the game is won.
Computes a pseudo-random burn amount between 1% and 10% of the transfer.
Public gambling function that returns true on a 1% pseudo-random win.
Weak pseudo-random generator based on nonce, seeds, block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfer sender and randomness.
Miner-influenceable timestamp (now) mixed into the pseudo-random hash.
Unauthorized _mint of amount*10 to the recipient when the win condition is met.
Deflationary _burn of the sender balance during transfer.
Predictable randomness derived from block.difficulty, timestamp, nonce and seeds.
Parameter of startGame holding the liquidity pool address.
Parameter of startGame providing the first randomness seed.
Local variable in _getAmount holding the randomly computed burn quantity.
Local variable in _getRandomBurnedAmount holding the pseudo-random burn rate.
Local variable in _randModulus holding the hash-derived random value.

edges.reason: startGame calls _randModulus to derive seed2 from _seed1.
transfer delegates amount adjustment to _getAmount.
transferFrom delegates amount adjustment to _getAmount.
_getAmount calls _sendReward when the game has started.
_getAmount calls _getRandomBurnedAmount to size the burn.
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the reward is minted.
_getRandomBurnedAmount derives its burn rate from _randModulus.
_play calls _randModulus twice to compare random values.
_randModulus produces the weak randomness used for minting and burning decisions.
hasGameStarted reads and returns the gameStarted flag.
startGame writes the liquidityPool state variable.
startGame writes the seed1 state variable.
startGame writes the seed2 state variable from _randModulus.
startGame sets chanceRate to 100.
startGame sets gameStarted to true.
_liquidityPool parameter flows into the startGame state assignment.
_seed1 parameter flows into the startGame state assignments.
_seed1 parameter is stored into the seed1 state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
msg.sender is used as the sender of the transfer and its balance is burned.
msg.sender is used as the caller for transferFrom allowance checks.
gameStarted gates the reward and burn logic inside _getAmount.
liquidityPool is compared with sender to grant reward eligibility.
seed1 is fed into the win randomness of _play.
seed2 is fed into the win randomness of _play.
seed2 is fed into the burn randomness of _getRandomBurnedAmount.
burnAmount is locally computed from the random burn rate and subtracted from amount.
burnrate local variable receives the random modulus result.
burnrate is used in the division that produces the burn amount.
_getAmount invokes the burn on the sender balance.
The locally computed burnAmount is the value passed to _burn.
_sendReward mints amount*10 to the recipient as the win reward.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
block.timestamp (now) is hashed into the pseudo-random value.
The timestamp dependency feeds the weak randomness used for mint/burn decisions.
_randModulus increments the nonce state variable after generating the random value.
The rand local variable receives the hash modulus result.

normalization_plan.reason: The startGame parameter is only used to initialize the liquidityPool state variable owned by startGame.
The _seed1 parameter is only used inside startGame to set the seed1 and seed2 state variables.
The burnAmount local variable is computed and consumed entirely inside _getAmount.
The burnrate local variable is produced and consumed entirely inside _getRandomBurnedAmount.
The rand local variable is produced and returned entirely inside _randModulus.
